property_summary: For any caller and any value v sent to Command, when the caller is Owner the reference contract forwards the same msg.value to the callee (so the callee can receive Ether), whereas the mutant that always forwards value 0 breaks this by not forwarding the funds for some inputs (when msg.value>0 and callee's fallback/receive behavior depends on funds).
change_summary: Change the call to use call with zero value so the forwarded msg.value is not sent; this can alter effects if the callee expected funds and thus may change subsequent observable state related to Command behavior.
